notes: AMD publishes no state-level or country-level jobs data. Footprint by country is property and equipment, net, from the FY2025 10-K, which now lists only the U.S., Singapore and Canada separately, with all other countries combined ($296M); India, Ireland and China (incl. Hong Kong), listed separately in the FY2024 10-K, are now inside 'Other countries', so their rows were removed. Employees by region come from AMD's online Corporate Responsibility data tables (columns 2022–2025; the 2025 year-end column is used, total 31,359 employees plus 14,483 temporary workers and contractors). Regions are not defined by country list. The 10-K says AMD's facilities include about 5.4 million square feet leased and 1.4 million owned worldwide but gives no square footage by site. No taxes-by-country report was found (only a UK tax strategy page).
